content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Rochester

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review the specific hour and year requirements for your background—secondary degree holders and bachelor's degree holders face different thresholds. Gather your project documentation now to streamline your application later.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® prep course. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere, interact with active certified practitioners, and build mastery of the PMBOK® Guide framework. Live instruction ensures real-time Q&A and peer interaction—no self-paced recordings.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your 35 contact hours, create your PMI account and complete the official PMP® application. Upload proof of education, project experience, and training completion. Pay the PMI exam fee and await approval—typically within one week.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and focused review sessions. Schedule your exam at an approved testing center or online. The exam tests your command of project-management processes, terminology, and real-world scenarios.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP®, you enter a three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through formal education, project work, or volunteer service. Renew your credential before expiration to keep it active and your career competitive.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
